warnings: *** THE CIRCUIT-TO-AREA MAPPING E-01 RECORDED AS ABSENT IS ACTUALLY HERE, AND THAT WARNING HAS BEEN REWRITTEN. *** E-01's LP diagram labels all four loaded ways identically (แสงสว่าง และเต้ารับ) and gives no areas, so that file first stated the mapping was not in the drawing set. It is: both E-02 plans carry bare circled home-run digits against the riser - 1 and 2 on the ground floor, 3 and 4 upstairs. Verified at 8x on the ground-floor riser beside the LP board. So circuits 1-2 serve ชั้นล่าง and 3-4 serve ชั้นบน. What is still NOT stated is which outlets fall on 1 versus 2, or on 3 versus 4 - the digits mark the home runs, not every point.

CEILING-FINISH CODES ARE TAGGED PER ROOM ON THESE PLANS and are the ฝ series defined on A-03: ฝ1 gypsum board internal, ฝ2 waterproof gypsum, ฝ3 timber eaves soffit. That is the only place in the set where each room's ceiling type is assigned, so it is recorded per room here rather than left to the legend.

GRID CHAIN MATCHES THE MASTER on both views: 3.50 + 2.20 + 3.00 = 8.70 with the 1.80 carport overhang beyond grid 4, and the full y chain 1.00 / 2.00 / 0.80 / 4.00 / 3.00 / 1.60 against 11.40. Two more independent confirmations.

LIGHT FITTINGS, SWITCHES AND OUTLETS ARE DRAWN BUT NOT COUNTED HERE. Each is a 5-10 px symbol and the house-07 lesson in the project log is explicit that counting switches as though they were luminaires is the single most common error class on these sheets. Rooms, their ceiling codes, the panel and the named special outlets are recorded; a per-room fitting count needs the full-size sheet and is deliberately not attempted.

*** THIS PLAN IS A THIRD, INDEPENDENT CONFIRMATION THAT THE UNNUMBERED UPSTAIRS BATHROOM IS ห้องน้ำ 2. *** A-05 labels it only ห้องน้ำ and that file inferred the number by elimination; A-12 is titled ขยายห้องน้ำ 2; and this electrical plan labels both rooms outright, ห้องน้ำ 1 and ห้องน้ำ 2. The inference recorded on A-05 is confirmed by two later sheets.
BOTH UPSTAIRS BATHROOMS TAKE ฝ2, the waterproof gypsum ceiling, and all three bedrooms take ฝ1 - consistent with the ground floor, where only ห้องน้ำ 3 takes ฝ2.
NO PANEL ON THIS FLOOR - see the ground-floor file. Circuits 3 and 4 run up from the LP board downstairs.
